attempts.text:
Resume

Harish Mallam 
Email: harishmallam143@gmail.com 
Phone: 9052127588
Address: Mothinagar, Hyderabad, TS. 
Objective:
Willing to join with and work for a highly progressive and well reputed organization. Where I can contribute creative ideas and build strategies for development in the role assigned which can lead towards success thereon. And ultimately want to be a part in the growth of the organization. 
Experience:
USM Business Systems
Working as Senior US Accounts Executive & Payroll Specialist from March 2026 Onwards 
· Onboarding New employees including documentation.
· Updating payroll sheet enter the payroll data
· Handling employee Accounts sheets updating hours, balances, deductions etc. 
·  Checking employees’ Earnings & Deductions etc.
· Payroll processing 
· Bonus Payroll Calucations
· Downloading Payroll reports
·  Releasing Employee Salary Advances, Subcontractor Expenses, Vendor payments.
· Accounts Receivables & Accounts payable 
· Assist with Finance Team For month end & year end Closing reports

Jigya Software Services
Working as Senior US Accounts Executive from July 2025 to February 2026.
· Using online tools like QuickBooks, ADP, Ceipal, Paycom, Google meet, zoom etc for Completing and handling various tasks.
· Handling employee Accounts sheets updating hours, balances, deductions etc. 
· Relationship with employee/Consultants educating them about their payroll, balance etc.
· Checking on time Accounts Receivable &Accounts payable 
· Handling payroll sheet updating payroll data.
· Bonus payroll Calculations 
Camelot Integrated Solutions Inc
Worked as US Accounts Executive from February 2024 July 2025
· Onboarding New employees including documentation.
· Invoice Submission in Client Portals On time like VMS, Nagarro, Oracle, Tech Mahindra
·  Accounts receivable follow-up’s
· Accounts payable 
· Enter the payroll data in ADP.
· Payroll processing
· Checking with immigration team new Employees States LCA Deductions etc.
· Taking care of conformation sheets from sales team for new placements. 
· Writing Immigration E-Cheeks.
· Creating journal entry’s
Skill tune Technologies Inc 
Worked as US Accounts Executive from January 2020 to January 2024.
· Timesheets follow-up from employees and sub-contractors.
· Sharing invoices with vendors and clients as per schedule.
· Doing day to day bank reconciliation with Quick Books
· Applying Incoming payments with QuickBooks 
· Credit Card Reconciliation 
· New Employee Onboarding 
· Payroll Sheet updating 
· Enter the payroll Data in ADP 
· Payroll Processing 
 Education:
· MBA from Satavahana University for the academic year 2017 to 2020 with 55%.
· Graduation from Satavahana University for the year 2014 to 2017 with 65%.
· Intermediate from BOI for the year 2012 to 2014 with 80%. 
· SSC from state Board for the academic year 2011 to 2012 with 6.2 GPA. 
Skills:
· Quick Books
· MS Office
· ADP 
· Ceipal 
· Paycom
· Paychex
Languages: 
 Telugu and English. 
Additional Information: 

Hi, 

I am Harish Mallam looking forward to associate with a organization like yours. Where I can learn and can contribute huge for the growth of the organization. 

Thank you, 
Harish Mallam.
